body.title: AgencyAnalytics Expert Needed for Executive-Level Multi-Channel Client Reporting
body.aiReason: Data visualization/dashboard focus aligns with skills; specific AgencyAnalytics reporting task is genuine and lacks red flags.
body.description:
We’re a B2B marketing agency looking for an experienced AgencyAnalytics and marketing reporting expert to quickly improve and standardize our client reports.
We need someone who can review our existing setup, recommend the right reporting structure, and move directly into building it. We’re not looking for a lengthy discovery or strategy process. The goal is a quick audit followed by hands-on execution.
We want to give clients a clean, executive-level view of overall performance with the ability to drill down by division, campaign, and platform. Our reporting currently includes Google Ads and Meta, with additional channels such as LinkedIn and Spotify added as needed.
The report should include:
Executive overview of total spend, reach, impressions, clicks, conversions, and cost per conversion
Performance by business division or service line
Campaign-level performance and conversion summaries
Platform-specific metrics and benchmarks where appropriate
Clear conversion breakdowns, including calls, forms, and other conversion types
Date comparisons and performance trends
A scalable template we can replicate across client accounts
A key part of this project is determining which metrics can be accurately combined across platforms and which should remain platform-specific. We also need help identifying and resolving discrepancies between conversion and call-tracking data.
Project approach:
Complete a quick audit of one existing AgencyAnalytics report
Confirm the recommended structure, metrics, and any limitations
Move directly into building or refining the report
Document the final setup so our team can maintain and replicate it
We’re ready to begin immediately and would prefer someone who can complete the audit and first report build quickly.
Please include:
Examples of AgencyAnalytics or similar multi-channel reports you’ve built
Your availability to begin
Your estimated turnaround time for the audit and initial build
A brief explanation of how you handle combined reporting across platforms without creating misleading metrics
